ops.title: uv sync --group docs removes the dev extra (pytest) from .venv; later uv run pytest falls through to an asdf shim and silently no-ops behind pipes
ops.body:
In captain-hook, `uv sync --group docs` (run before a docs build) removes packages from unrequested extras — including pytest from `--extra dev`. A later `uv run pytest` then resolves via the asdf shim on PATH, prints "No version is set for command pytest" (exit 126), and a trailing `| tail` masks the failure as exit 0, so `&&` chains report green without running any tests.

**Why:** uv sync is exact — it prunes anything not in the requested extras/groups. The asdf fallthrough makes the failure look like noise instead of an error.

**How to apply:** Sync with both: `uv sync --extra dev --group docs`. When verifying via piped pytest, capture `${PIPESTATUS[0]}` (or drop the pipe); treat "python 3.13.8 / 3.11.7" asdf advice in test output as a missing-binary failure, not noise. The pruning also happens *indirectly*: any bare `uv run <cmd>` (e.g. by a subagent running `uv run capt-hook ... test`) implicitly re-syncs to project defaults and prunes the docs group, so a later `uv run great-docs` fails with "Failed to spawn" — use `uv run --no-sync` for every command after the combined sync, and re-sync before the docs build if subagents ran uv in between. The same pruning bites bare `uv run pytest` itself — it re-syncs without extras, pruning the dev extra pytest lives in; in captain-hook run `uv sync --extra dev` once, then `.venv/bin/pytest` directly (the full suite also outruns the 600s Bash cap — run it as a session-owned background task and judge by exit code). Related: [[uv-exclude-newer-rolling-window]], [[rtk-diff-misreports-identical]] (rtk also eats the "N passed" pytest summary line, so the exit code is the only reliable signal).
